```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

data <- read.csv("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣公車.csv",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


date1 <- as.Date(data$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd.)
data$year <- year(date1)
data$month <- month(date1)


data_use <- data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025))


month_table <- table(data_use$year, data_use$month)
month_table <- as.matrix(month_table)

month_table[is.na(month_table)] <- 0


png("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/112年至114年1月至12月臺東縣市區客運月總運量折線圖.png",
    width = 12, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)

par(
  family = "yui",
  mar = c(5,6,6,10),
  mgp = c(4.1,1,0)   
)
windowsFonts(yui = windowsFont("Microsoft JhengHei"))


plot(
  1:12,
  month_table["2023",],
  type = "o",
  pch = 16,           
  lwd = 2.5,
  col = "gray10",
  ylim = c(0, max(month_table)*1.2),
  xlab = "月份",
  ylab = "搭乘次數",
  xaxt = "n",
  yaxt = "n",        
  bty = "n",
  cex.lab = 1.6

)


axis(1, at = 1:12, labels = 1:12)


axis(
  2,
  at = pretty(c(0, max(month_table))),
  las = 1,
  cex.axis = 1.2
)


lines(
  1:12,
  month_table["2024",],
  type = "o",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2.5,
  col = "gray40"
)

lines(
  1:12,
  month_table["2025",],
  type = "o",
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2.5,
  col = "gray70"
)


title(
  main = "112年至114年1月至12月臺東縣市區客運月總運量折線圖",
  adj = 0,
  cex.main = 1.8
)


legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("112年", "113年", "114年"),
  col = c("gray10", "gray40", "gray70"),
  pch = 16,
  lwd = 2.5,
  bty = "n",
  inset = c(-0.15, 0),
  xpd = TRUE
)


dev.off()
```
